comment: Koa 3 on Node 26, with @koa/router and the Koa organisation's middleware as route middleware in front of each family's handlers, in TypeScript that Node runs without a build step. The suite is UnitTests/, node:test with supertest over app.callback(), and never reaches the image. install-ci-test is npm ci then npm test, because the suite needs node_modules and the typechecker. upgrade is npm update, which moves package-lock.json within the ranges package.json states. app.silent is set, so Koa writes no error to stderr.

noHandler.errors.unmatched: Koa answers a request no middleware answered with 404 and the status message, as text.
noHandler.errors.wrong_method: @koa/router's allowedMethods() answers a method the path has no route for with 405, an Allow header and the status message, as text.

authorized.mechanism: Route middleware that compares the bearer token with ctx.assert, which throws Koa's 403 for any other

baseline.builtin: The handler sets the string as the body, which Koa sends as text/plain.

body.mechanism: @koa/bodyparser parses every route's body, and koa-parameter's verifyParams checks the validate routes' against the parameter library's rules, its middleware answering a failure with 422

cache.mechanism: koa-cash as route middleware over an lru-cache store, keyed by the path and the headers each vary route names, with the serial kept beside each stored answer

compressed.mechanism: koa-compress as route middleware, at its default threshold and zlib's fastest level

cors.mechanism: @koa/cors as route middleware on an OPTIONS route and on the GET route, allowing settings.json's origin by a function

errors.builtin: Koa answers a request nothing answered with 404, @koa/router's allowedMethods() a method the path lacks with 405, and Koa's error handling writes the body parser's 400 and ctx.throw's 404 for a missing row, each as the status message in text.

etag.mechanism: @koa/etag as route middleware, which hashes the body with SHA-1, behind koa-conditional-get, which answers a matching If-None-Match with 304

forms.mechanism: @koa/bodyparser reads the urlencoded body and @koa/multer the upload, each as route middleware

headers.builtin: The handler reads the three headers with ctx.get and converts the account with Number(). Koa binds nothing.

items.builtin: One route per method on /items/:id, the id converted by router.param. @koa/router answers HEAD with the GET route.

json.builtin: The handler sets the payload object as the body, which Koa writes with JSON.stringify.

middleware.mechanism: No-op async middleware in front of the route's handler, four or sixteen of them

parameters.mechanism: router.param, @koa/router's hook for a named capture, which converts each capture to a number before the route's middleware runs

query.builtin: Koa parses the query string into ctx.query, and the handler converts the numbers with Number(). Koa binds nothing.

sse.builtin: Koa has no helper for server-sent events. The handler sets text/event-stream and gives Koa a Readable of data lines, which Koa pipes into the response, as the Koa organisation's stream-server-side-events example does.

static.mechanism: @koa/send on one /static/:name route over the payload directory

stream.builtin: The handler sets a Readable of lines as the body, which Koa pipes into the response.

template.mechanism: @koa/ejs rendering an EJS template through ctx.render
